narrative.text:
NARRATIVE:

Facts of Arrest: On April 8, 2017, at approximately 2000 hours, a Michigan State Trooper requested assistance from the U.S. Border Patrol with three individuals. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] arrived on scene and questioned the three individuals as to their immigration status. One individual was a Legal Alien Permanent Resident, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] (Honduras, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] ). The other two individuals [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] (Nicaragua, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] (Nicaragua, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] ) admitted they were illegally present in the United States and did not possess any immigration documents to remain or pass through the United States.

The illegal immigrants were arrested and transported to [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] station at 2145 hours by Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] One subject was processed as a WA/NTA and the second subject was processed as a Reinstate. Upon further questioning it was discovered that there was another vehicle following them. Agents went looking for the other vehicle [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] . The vehicle was located in St. Ignace at the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] After agents knocked on the window, the driver accelerated away from the agent. A pursuit followed and the vehicle eventually stopped at [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] and passenger took off on foot. The driver, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] a Legal Alien Permanent Resident remained in the vehicle. The passenger, the owner of the vehicle, is [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] . Records checks through Central Dispatch returned with negative results. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] was taken into custody by Michigan State Police for Resisting and Obstructing a police officer. Removability: Subject is inadmissible under 212(a) (6) (A) (i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, as amended in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled, or who arrived in the United States at any time or place other than as designated by the Attorney General.

ENTRY:

[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] (DOB: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] COC: Nicaragua) claims to have entered into the United States in August 2013 by flying into Chicago O'Hare International Airport on a tourist visa. He stated that he did not cross through a designated Port of Entry and was not inspected or admitted by an immigration official. IMMIGRATION HISTORY: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] has no prior immigration history. CRIMINAL HISTORY: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] has no prior criminal history. HEALTHY: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] claims and appears to be in good health and is not taking any medications. EQUITIES: 1116 U.S. Dollars DISPOSITION: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] was served a Warrant of Arrest/Notice to Appear. Subject and his personal property were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] county jail pending removal proceedings.
